findings.title: Clarify the color scope of the 25 and 30 lb filler rows
findings.description: The combined Clear and Clear/Blue Fluorescent scope is numerically valid as a union, but the 2016 primary availability grid marks the 25 lb / 250 yd and 30 lb / 220 yd fillers only in Clear/Blue Fluorescent. The Clear cells are blank. Generic row evidence and chart wording could be read as supporting both colors at these strengths.
findings.sourceLocation: Printed page 2 / archive page 3, Original Filler Spools availability grid, 25 and 30 lb rows
findings.recommendedChange: State Clear and Clear/Blue Fluorescent for the listed 4-20 lb fillers, and Clear/Blue Fluorescent only at 25/30 lb. Add the specific color to those two row evidence strings or package entries. Preserve all verified diameters, yardages, strengths and IDs.
findings.resolution: Applied the explicit color restriction to Original's product chartNote/chartCaption and archive-ready rowContext, which regenerates the evidence strings with the exact restriction. No numeric rows changed. Added a scoped regression assertion for the 25/30 lb evidence.

modelReviews.scope: Only 8 lb Ultracast x8 Inshore Camo, 164 yd / 150 m. Current US product page links artwork whose filename includes 2019; no claim that all variants or stock are verified.

primaryNumericEvidence.independentlyReadLabel: LB-TEST 8 LB / 3.6 KG; LENGTH 164 yd / 150 m; SIZE 0.0035 in / 0.09 mm; MAX BREAK 22 LB / 10.1 KG
primaryNumericEvidence.check: 8 is the test rating, not maximum break 22 or a gou conversion. The printed pair is consistent within rounding: 0.0035 in = 0.0889 mm. Yard/meter labels describe one package.

modelReviews.marketAndDate: US page-link identity independently rechecked with web open and image-link follow. Page lists 8 lb and 164 yd options; the package itself establishes their combination. Source note explicitly discloses the 2019 artwork filename and disclaims stock.
modelReviews.identityAndDefaults: Only one numeric row. Default is spiderwire-ultracast-braid-braid-8 / 164 yd. Both examples use that row. All six legacy 10/15/20/30/40/50 lb IDs are excluded.
modelReviews.copy: Useful and carefully limited: light-braid suitability, test versus maximum break, large-capacity sensitivity, backing and working reserve are explained. Does not claim all inshore fishing suits 8 lb.
